content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a setup where a [product_name] controller is using a [product_name] module as a remote I/O replacement, managed in [product_name] [version_no]. I want to monitor the connection status so a fault can be triggered if the connection is lost, but I'm unable to locate documentation explaining how to achieve this for the [product_name] connection.

I recommend implementing a watchdog function. For example: utilize an asynchronous pulse generator to create a clock signal—alternating 1 second on, 1 second off. Transmit this signal to the [product_name] controller and have it sent back from the [product_name] controller to the [product_name] module. Monitor the returned signal for both high and low states using two switch-on delays (set at 1.5 seconds). If either delay expires, it indicates disrupted communication. Apply the same logic in the [product_name] controller for two-way monitoring, ensuring both devices can identify interruptions.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking reliable ways to observe the connection status between a [product_name] controller and a [product_name] module configured as remote I/O, but finds documentation lacking on detecting and responding to communication faults. Another user suggests a custom watchdog solution to monitor connectivity, pointing out the absence of straightforward or documented built-in features for this scenario.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have a clear method and documentation within the [product_name] engineering environment to monitor connection status and automatically manage faults between a [product_name] controller and a [product_name] module.
